# Validation report

*Release: rubric 0.2.0, engine 0.1.6, data snapshot 2026-10-24. Generated by `ingest/make_validation_report.py` from the run's own outputs; do not edit by hand. PRD section 17, D7. Methods: `docs/methodology-note.md`, section 6.*

## Summary

- **Retrospective, development set** (35 published diagnoses, rubric 0.2.0, Standard, pooled): false rule-out 6.0% (6 of 100; Wilson 2.8–12.5%); hit 4.0% (4 of 100; Wilson 1.6–9.8%); false alarm 5.1% (12 of 237; Wilson 2.9–8.6%); cannot tell 87.5% (295 of 337; Wilson 83.6–90.6%). Verdict: split. See section 5.
- **Retrospective, holdout set** (22 published diagnoses, rubric 0.2.0, Standard, pooled): false rule-out 4.0% (3 of 75; Wilson 1.4–11.1%); hit 12.0% (9 of 75; Wilson 6.4–21.3%); false alarm 5.3% (7 of 131; Wilson 2.6–10.6%); cannot tell 86.4% (178 of 206; Wilson 81.1–90.4%). Verdict: inconclusive (12 BINDING pairs in rule-out or flag; the protocol needs 20). See section 5.
- **The protocol is complete.** No rubric parameter was tuned to these labels (the one round of fixes was forgone, amendment 4). The ratings are neither validated nor killed: the test was too small to pass or fail its own primary bar, so they stay uncalibrated.
- **Internal checks pass:** 110 of 110 engine tests; the statsmodels re-estimate of the residuals agrees (largest gap in t 0.030); 1430 of 1430 outputs reproduce from the release.
- **Verdicts:** of 3,472 scored node rows (217 economies), 2,959 (85 percent) are a "cannot tell"; 0 reach an extreme tier.
- **Test 4 kill criterion:** 1 of 3 vectors pass (CH.SKILL); CH.FIN, CH.TIME fail and are shown but not counted.

## 3. Test 4 kill criterion

Each real intensity vector against 99 industry-permuted placebos (seed 20261029). It must beat the placebos' 95th percentile on both: the rank correlation of θ between 2019 and 2024 (stability), and the rank correlation of θ estimated from RCA with θ from export shares.

| Vector | Stability: real | placebo 95th pct | RCA vs share: real | placebo 95th pct | Passes |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| External finance dependence (Rajan-Zingales), N0 and N3 | 0.957 | 0.941 | 0.695 | 0.725 | no, shown only |
| Schooling intensity (Ciccone-Papaioannou), N4 | 0.963 | 0.950 | 0.724 | 0.701 | yes, counted |
| Transport time sensitivity (Hummels-Schaur air share), N6 | 0.944 | 0.861 | 0.501 | 0.528 | no, shown only |

## 4. Coverage

- Nodes that are a data gap for every economy: N2, N8, N11.crime.
- Economies with no usable indicator: 18 (American Samoa; Channel Islands; Cuba; Eritrea; Gibraltar; Guam; Isle of Man; Liechtenstein; St. Martin (French part); Monaco; Northern Mariana Islands; New Caledonia; Korea, Dem. People's Rep.; French Polynesia; South Sudan; Venezuela, RB; British Virgin Islands; Yemen, Rep.).
- Comparator sets: 31 economies have no aspirational set; 18 have a structural set shorter than ten.
- Engine warnings: 8 (listed in `out/engine-report.json`).
